_readme: Portfolio records and gallery taxonomy. ONE media collection drives Home Selected Work and every service gallery (Real Estate, Agent Content, Architecture & Design, Commercial, Creator Studios); there is no standalone Work page (James, Sep 25); never copy a record into a second list. Add a project to 'projects' and its media to 'media'. Media paths are relative to site.json media.base unless they start with http or /v/ (encoded by scripts/media.mjs from content/media-sources.json, keyed by the same id). rights: 'approved' | 'pending'. published: false keeps a record out of production (review builds show it with a Needs approval tag). packageIds: verified HD Photo Hub package ids (luxury-media, signature, social-media, listing-starter) ONLY after checking the service delivered or James's approval; leave [] when unknown. capturedYear: actual shoot year, or null when not confirmed (never guessed from Drive folders). sortPriority: higher shows first; ties keep file order. Use scripts/ingest.mjs to add and tag records. clientId: verified client/project identity (Codex/James catalog, Sep 24); Commercial groups media by clientId, never by category alone. Project path: the service URL of its case study (old /work/<slug> redirects there).

taxonomy._segmentReadme: Architecture & Design gallery segments (James, Sep 27 2026). A PROJECT carries 'segments' only with evidence recorded in 'segmentSource'; its media inherit them. Never infer a segment from a house name. A segment with no mapped media is not shown as a filter.
